schema.text: Compared to other travel options available to you (e.g., walking, driving, public transport), how would you rate the overall effort required by your usual mode of travel?

options.text: My current mode is significantly easier and more relaxing than any alternative
This is a bit easier than other ways I could travel
Regardless of the mode the effort feels roughly equal
This takes a bit more out of me than other options would
Far more demanding than alternatives (physically or mentally)

en.#Compared to other travel options availa: Compared to other travel options available to you (e.g., walking, driving, public transport), how would you rate the overall effort required by your usual mode of travel?
en.#My current mode is significantly easier: My current mode is significantly easier and more relaxing than any alternative
en.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: This is a bit easier than other ways I could travel
en.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Regardless of the mode the effort feels roughly equal
en.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: This takes a bit more out of me than other options would
en.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Far more demanding than alternatives (physically or mentally)

it.#Compared to other travel options availa: Rispetto alle altre modalità di trasporto a tua disposizione (ad es. a piedi, in auto, con il trasporto pubblico), come valuteresti lo sforzo complessivo richiesto dalla modalità che utilizzi abitualmente?
it.#My current mode is significantly easier: La modalità che utilizzo attualmente è decisamente più facile e rilassante di qualsiasi alternativa
it.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: È un po' più facile rispetto alle altre modalità con cui potrei spostarmi
it.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Indipendentemente dalla modalità, lo sforzo mi sembra più o meno equivalente
it.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Questa modalità richiede un po' più di energie rispetto alle altre opzioni
it.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Molto più impegnativa delle alternative, dal punto di vista fisico o mentale

fr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Par rapport aux autres possibilités de déplacement dont vous disposez, par exemple la marche, la voiture ou les transports publics, comment évaluez-vous l’effort global demandé par votre mode de transport habituel ?
fr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mon mode actuel est nettement plus facile et plus reposant que toutes les autres possibilités
fr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: C’est un peu plus facile que les autres façons dont je pourrais me déplacer
fr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Quel que soit le mode, l’effort me semble à peu près le même
fr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ce mode me demande un peu plus d’effort que les autres possibilités
fr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Beaucoup plus exigeant que les autres possibilités, physiquement ou mentalement

de.#Compared to other travel options availa: Verglichen mit anderen Möglichkeiten, die Ihnen zur Verfügung stehen, zum Beispiel Gehen, Autofahren oder öffentlicher Verkehr: Wie hoch ist der gesamte Aufwand bei Ihrem üblichen Verkehrsmittel?
de.#My current mode is significantly easier: Mein derzeitiges Verkehrsmittel ist deutlich einfacher und entspannter als alle Alternativen
de.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Es ist etwas einfacher als andere Möglichkeiten, die ich nutzen könnte
de.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Unabhängig vom Verkehrsmittel fühlt sich der Aufwand ungefähr gleich an
de.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Dieses Verkehrsmittel kostet mich etwas mehr Kraft als andere Möglichkeiten
de.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Deutlich anstrengender als die Alternativen, körperlich oder mental

tr.#Compared to other travel options availa: Yürüme, otomobil veya toplu taşıma gibi kullanabileceğiniz diğer seçeneklerle karşılaştırıldığında, genellikle kullandığınız ulaşım seçeneğinin gerektirdiği toplam çabayı nasıl değerlendirirsiniz?
tr.#My current mode is significantly easier: Şu an kullandığım seçenek diğer tüm alternatiflerden belirgin şekilde daha kolay ve rahat
tr.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Kullanabileceğim diğer seçeneklerden biraz daha kolay
tr.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: Hangi ulaşım seçeneğini kullansam da gereken çaba yaklaşık aynı
tr.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Bu seçenek diğerlerine göre biraz daha fazla enerji harcamamı gerektiriyor
tr.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Alternatiflere göre fiziksel veya zihinsel olarak çok daha yorucu

fa.#Compared to other travel options availa: در مقایسه با گزینه‌های دیگر مانند پیاده‌روی، رانندگی یا حمل‌ونقل عمومی، میزان تلاش کلی موردنیاز برای روش معمول رفت‌وآمد خود را چگونه ارزیابی می‌کنید؟
fa.#My current mode is significantly easier: روش فعلی من به‌طور محسوسی آسان‌تر و آرام‌تر از همه گزینه‌های دیگر است
fa.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: کمی آسان‌تر از روش‌های دیگری است که می‌توانم استفاده کنم
fa.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: صرف‌نظر از روش، میزان تلاش تقریباً یکسان است
fa.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: این روش کمی بیشتر از گزینه‌های دیگر از من انرژی می‌گیرد
fa.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: از نظر جسمی یا ذهنی بسیار سخت‌تر از گزینه‌های دیگر است

hu.#Compared to other travel options availa: Az Ön számára elérhető más lehetőségekhez, például gyalogláshoz, autózáshoz vagy tömegközlekedéshez képest hogyan értékeli a szokásos közlekedési módjához szükséges teljes erőfeszítést?
hu.#My current mode is significantly easier: A jelenlegi közlekedési módom lényegesen könnyebb és nyugodtabb minden más lehetőségnél
hu.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: Ez egy kicsit könnyebb, mint más módok, amelyeket használhatnék
hu.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: A közlekedési módtól függetlenül nagyjából ugyanakkora erőfeszítésnek érzem
hu.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: Ez valamivel több energiát vesz ki belőlem, mint a többi lehetőség
hu.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: Sokkal megterhelőbb a többi lehetőségnél, fizikailag vagy lelkileg

ar.#Compared to other travel options availa: مقارنةً بوسائل التنقل الأخرى المتاحة لك، مثل المشي أو القيادة أو النقل العام، كيف تقيّم إجمالي الجهد المطلوب لاستخدام وسيلة التنقل المعتادة لديك؟
ar.#My current mode is significantly easier: وسيلتي الحالية أسهل وأكثر راحة بوضوح من أي بديل
ar.#This is a bit easier than other ways I: هي أسهل قليلًا من الطرق الأخرى التي يمكنني استخدامها
ar.#Regardless of the mode the effort feels: بغض النظر عن الوسيلة، أشعر أن الجهد متقارب تقريبًا
ar.#This takes a bit more out of me than ot: هذه الوسيلة تتطلب مني طاقة أكبر قليلًا من الخيارات الأخرى
ar.#Far more demanding than alternatives (p: أكثر إرهاقًا بكثير من البدائل، جسديًا أو نفسيًا
